saved mask comes from C6, which reloads the C5 region arrays from /tmp/c.npz. It builds per-cell ±5-day hazen 90th-percentile thresholds over 1992–2002 (with the edge days), smooths them with a wrapped 31-day mean, and compares them with the 2012-06-01..08-31 SST of every sea cell. Run detection and gap joining in C6:L24-L42 then produce the mask written in C6:L53. Only threshold days 138–259 are needed for the target dates, so the baseline values that reach the mask are 12 May–20 Sep of each year 1992–2002."}
